operations.description: 完整替换该角色的用户目标，先验证全部原始目标及实际移除对象；只增删差量并使新增／移除用户失效，保留成员关系及版本。合法等价集合不提升版本；不以最终有效权限重复豁免真实归属变化。
完整替换组织成员目标，全部原始目标与实际移除对象仍须满足范围、存在和保护前提。只增删差量并使实际新增／移除用户失效，保留成员的joined_at及版本；合法等价集合不提升版本，不额外失效其他范围数据读取者。已有本人／受保护关系仅可原样保留。
先按既有Ensure规则锁定／初始化共享授权版本并比较expected_access_version，再完成身份、保护、范围和角色引用校验。合法等价集合返回当前access_version，不重建保留关系、不提升版本；真实关系变化仅提升目标一次。同旧版本最多一项真实修改提交；真实修改后旧版本请求即使集合相同仍返回409 AUTHZ_CONFLICT。
先按既有Ensure规则锁定／初始化共享版本并比较expected_access_version，再校验身份、保护、范围和全部组织引用；仅替换可管理关系，隐藏归属及保留joined_at不变。合法等价目标返回当前access_version，真实变化只提升目标一次。同旧版本最多一项真实修改提交；旧版本请求即使当前集合相同仍返回409 ORG_CONFLICT。

implementation.cutover: All old full-delete persistence APIs/callers removed; test-only replacement setup helpers are not production shims.
implementation.comparison: Existing guards/current locked facts then owner-local deltas; manageable organization subset only.
implementation.version: Bulk symmetric difference only; per-user Ensure+CAS then no-op/current or one real increment, attempt-local results.
implementation.timestamp: Logical joined_at maps to physical Membership.CreatedAt/user_organizations.created_at; retained rows never reconstructed.

scope_limits: Native original main covers actual authentication, permissions, scoped management and cross-owner HTTP; owner SQLite tests use bounded policy facts and real persisted versions.
Tagged MySQL tests isolate their own schemas; controlled HTTP CAS cases record actual hierarchy/identity/version waits rather than claiming launch timing.
SIGNAL retry witnesses are throwaway owned MyISAM fixtures, not physical deadlock coverage or production schema.
No final effective-permission diff, scope-reader invalidation, hierarchy-move I4, new retries or new version fields.
C6 non-login missing-version authentication evidence is historical reuse because that read path is unchanged; management initial Ensure1 remains intentionally distinct.
